entries.reason: Same test (334): a RETURN TRANSID that succeeds ends the task, so the arm where RESP is NORMAL is never executed.

DELCUS copies INQCUST's INQ-FAIL-CD into COMM-DEL-FAIL-CD (DELCUS 266) and sets no other failure code; INQCUST answers only '1' (318-319, 346-347), '2' (544-545) and '9' (604-605, 637-638, 664-665), never '3', so `COMM-DEL-FAIL-CD = '3'` is never true.

UPDCUST's other failure codes are 'T' (invalid title, UPDCUST 192-193) and '4' (name and address both blank or leading-space, 264-266). 'T': UPDCUST's title list is BNK1DCS ED2010's (723-756) plus the blank title, which EDIT-DATA2 refuses, so a title UPDCUST rejects never gets past 'Valid titles are'. '4': it needs a name beginning with a space, whose UNSTRING title is blank and so refused at 756 first, so the LINK is never made.
`IF SEND-DATAONLY` tests the 88 on the flag value '2' (line 51), set by no statement: only `SET SEND-ERASE` (208) and `SET SEND-DATAONLY-ALARM` (300, 486) write SEND-FLAG.

`IF SEND-DATAONLY-ALARM` is reached only with the flag '3': '1' (SEND-ERASE) takes the SEND MAP ERASE branch ahead of it and ends at SM999, and '2' is never set (see 1486), so the test is always true.
